name: Honda Valkyrie (GL1500C)
engine: 1520 cc liquid-cooled flat six, six carbs, shaft drive
intro: A Gold Wing flat six in a cruiser. Six carbs to sync, and a shaft drive to grease.

add.title: Check the rear wheel bearings
add.instructions: With the rear wheel off the ground, rock it side to side and spin it. Any play or roughness means new bearings.
add.reason: Owners of the Interstate model have reported repeated rear wheel bearing failures.

G: Sync all six carbs after a rebuild. It is a long job, so set aside the time.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Rear wheel bearings
known.what: An owner of a 1999 Valkyrie Interstate reported the left rear wheel bearing failing three times.
